games.title: Apricots
games.desc:
Apricots has nothing to do with apricots. It's a game where you fly a little plane around the screen and shoot things and drop bombs on enemy targets, and it's meant to be quick and fun.

Big thanks to [Moggers87](https://github.com/moggers87/apricots) for producing this game. 

The [source](https://github.com/moggers87/apricots)
games.instructionsRaw:
At present there is no option screen. Options can be changed by editing the configuration file apricots.cfg. This is first searched for in ~/.config/apricots/, then the system configuration directory (usually /usr/local/etc or /etc) and finally the default configuration in the data directory.

The number and type of planes can be varied, along with the airbases, as can 1/2 player game be chosen. The number of anti aircraft guns and scenery can be selected. Draks can be turned on or off, and a different condition for winning the game can be chosen.

games.instructionsMd:
## Installation

Requires the **macOS** version from GOG or Steam.

### GOG (recommended)
1. Purchase on [GOG](https://www.gog.com/game/crypt_of_the_necrodancer)
2. Download the **macOS** `.pkg` installer(s) — base game plus any DLC
3. Place all `.pkg` files in `necrodancer/gamedata/`
4. Launch — extraction happens automatically (may take 10+ minutes per .pkg)

### Steam
1. Purchase on [Steam](https://store.steampowered.com/app/247080/Crypt_of_the_NecroDancer/)
2. Download both Mac depots: `download_depot 247080 247082` and `download_depot 247080 247086`
3. Place `depot_247082/` and `depot_247086/` in `necrodancer/gamedata/`
4. Launch — the patcher merges the depots automatically

games.instructionsRaw:
Start the program

Multiple instances of the game may be started on the same machine for testing.
The server (Server.exe) need only be run if you want a stand alone server.
Firewall ports

TCP port 1999 needs to be forwarded in your firewall/router to be able to host games and have other players join you.
Login as member

To use achievements and hiscores you need to create a user here.
Then login as that user, or select cancel to just play directly.
Connect to server

Enter the IP address or host name of a server and click "connect".
You can enter 127.0.0.1 to connect to your own server.
All games on that server will be shown.
You can join green games.
You can't join red games, they are full or already started.
If no game is shown you have to create a new game.
Join existing game

Enter your name and choose a green game from the list.
Click "Join".
Create new game

Enter your name, and the name of the game.
Click "New".
Start game

The player that created the game should set the level to play and make other settings before starting the game. This player will be the master.
Others that have joined can only chat until the game starts.

The master can kick players by selecting a player and press delete.
If the master leaves the game, mastership is transferred to another player.

games.title: Insaniquarium Deluxe
games.desc:
Insaniquarium Deluxe (PopCap, 2004) running natively on aarch64.

Not an emulator: this is the WinFish decompilation of the game, ported from the original SexyAppFramework to PopLib, which replaces DirectDraw with SDL3. Module music is played with libopenmpt. The binary is native aarch64 and depends on no closed-source libraries.

The game is played entirely with the pointer, so the gamepad acts as a mouse: stick and d-pad move it, A left clicks, B right clicks, and L1/R1 slow it down for hitting coins and small fish. Options has an Auto Collect switch that puts every coin in the tank on the Y button, for anyone who would rather not wear out A.
games.instructionsRaw:
This port does NOT include the game. Copy the data, images, music, properties, sounds and fishsongs folders from your copy of Insaniquarium Deluxe (Steam) into ports/insaniquarium/.

Watch the letter case: Windows ignores it and Linux does not. If the game complains about an image that clearly exists, that is almost always why.

games.title: Jazz2 Resurrection
games.desc:
"Jazz² Resurrection" is a reimplementation of "Jazz Jackrabbit 2", a superb 2D platformer released in 1998 by Epic Megagames as a sequel to the shareware classic "Jazz Jackrabbit" (also available on PortMaster).

Supports various versions of the game (Jazz Jackrabbit 2 (v1.20/1.23), as well as Shareware Demo, Holiday Hare '98, The Secret Files, and Christmas Chronicles).
games.instructionsRaw: Copy the contents of your original "Jazz Jackrabbit 2" game directory to "ports/jazz2/Source/". Cache files will be recreated during the intro cutscene the first time the game is run, so it can't be skipped. The intro cutscene's sound effects require these cache files, so they will be missing the first time the game is run.
games.instructionsMd:
### Do I need the original *Jazz Jackrabbit 2* game?
Yes, this project uses assets from the original game. *Jazz Jackrabbit 2* game files must be copied into the `ports/jazz2/Source/` directory.
### Which versions of *Jazz Jackrabbit 2* are supported?
The Following versions of the original game can be used:
* Jazz Jackrabbit 2: Shareware Demo
* **Jazz Jackrabbit 2 (v1.20/1.23)**
* Jazz Jackrabbit 2: Holiday Hare '98
* **Jazz Jackrabbit 2: The Secret Files**
* **Jazz Jackrabbit 2: Christmas Chronicles**

Only the versions listed in **bold** are required for a complete collection. When importing multiple versions into *Jazz² Resurrection*, copy each game's files into `ports/jazz2/Source/`—in the order listed above—replacing all files each time.

Some releases of *The Secret Files* contain an extra `xmas1.j2l` file which shouldn't be there. This file breaks *The Christmas Chronicles*. To fix this issue, either do not copy the file, or, replace it with the version of the file from *The Christmas Chronicles*. *Holiday Hare '98* and *The Christmas Chronicles* are nearly identical, except that *The Christmas Chronicles* also contains Lori as playable character, so it is the preferred version. The *Secret Files Demo* is not supported, only the original *Shareware Demo* is.
games.requiredDataHint: Скопируйте оригинальные файлы игры в папку ports/jazz2/Source

games.title: Limbo

- Purchase Limbo (Mobile) on the Epic Games Store (store.epicgames.com/p/limbo-mobile-android-300111?lang=en-US) (Play Store version WILL NOT work!)and install it on an Android device.
- Extract the installed APK (single APK, no split install, any APK extractor or adb pull works).
- Use 7zip to unzip the .apk file. 
- Copy the whole assets/ and lib/ folders into ports/limbo/.
- Run Limbo.

The gameplay of Little Runmo - The Game, is based on the video but also takes inspiration from the Super Mario games. For fans that come from the animation, the game is not a 1 to 1 replica of the animated film. I am not trying to make this a hardcore Meatboy-type game, I want to introduce challenging moments but I will try to make the difficulty curve as smooth as possible.

The early game will be pretty chill, just imagine how the Mario games were designed, then newer harder mechanics get slowly introduced. Big inspirations again were Mario World and Super Mario Bros Wii and also a fan-game called Mario 63.

games.title: Max Payne
games.desc: Max Payne Mobile Android version ported to ARM64 Linux devices.
games.instructionsRaw: Original Android APK (version 1.7) and OBB files need to be under /ports/maxpayne/
games.instructionsMd:
## Installing

1. Install Max Payne through PortMaster
2. Install the game (Max Payne Mobile 1.7 or newer so that it includes Arm64 libs) on your Android device from Google Play or other legit source.
3. Retrieve the APK and OBB files from your Android device. You can use a apk extractor app or connect your device to a computer and copy the files directly. Many ways to achieve this so just google it. If you don't have an Android device or you are running a a too new Android version, you can use an emulator like [BlueStacks 5](https://www.bluestacks.com/bluestacks-5.html) and [set your Android version to an older one](https://support.bluestacks.com/hc/en-us/articles/360058931031-How-to-utilize-the-different-Android-versions-available-on-BlueStacks-5).
4. Copy the APK and OBB files over to the console (SD card or over SSH). Place them in the `/ports/maxpayne/` directory.
5. Launch Max Payne from the Ports menu. The first time you launch the game, it will unpack the APK and OBB files. This may take a few minutes.
6. After unpacking, the game will start loading. Enjoy playing Max Payne on your device!
games.requiredDataHint: Поместите требуемые файлы игры (или проверьте инструкцию) в папку ports/maxpayne/

games.instructionsRaw: Go on the PortMaster Website to see the instructions
games.instructionsMd:
To play Minecraft on your device via PortMaster, you’ll need to copy over the necessary game files from your PC. Follow these steps carefully:
✅ Step 1: Prepare Minecraft on Your PC

    Install Minecraft on your PC via the official launcher.

    Launch the version you want to play at least once to make sure all files are generated.

    (Optional but important!)
    If you want to use a mod loader like Forge or Fabric, install it and launch that version once as well.

📂 Step 2: Find the Game Files

On your PC, Minecraft stores game files in this folder:

C:\Users\<YourUsername>\AppData\Roaming\.minecraft\versions

To access that folder Press the Windows Key on your Keyboard and R
    Win + R
You should see a new Window called Run, in there write %appdata% and press Enter

Now you should see a .minecraft directory

📁 Step 3: Copy to Your PortMaster Device

    Connect your device to your PC or insert the SD card.

    On your device, go to:

    /ports/minecraftjava

    Now copy the earlier found .minecraft Directory from Step 2 into the /ports/minecraftjava folder
    If it asks to overwrite files press NO !!!

games.title: Moonlight New
games.desc: "Moonlight Embedded is an open source client for Sunshine and NVIDIA GameStream for embedded Linux systems. Moonlight allows you to stream your full collection of games and applications from your PC to other devices to play them remotely". Now with a brand new custom-made launcher!"
games.instructionsRaw: Install the latest version of Sunshine on your PC and use the launcher to pair to your pc. Full instructions are on the PortMaster site!
games.instructionsMd:
- Install the latest version of [Sunshine](https://github.com/LizardByte/Sunshine/releases) on your PC *(GFE is not updated anymore but may give good results for NVIDIA users)*
- This guide will use the windows installer version. 
- Run the installer, agree with the terms. Wait for it to finish.
- Open Sunshine for the first time. It will open up a window in your default browser.
- It may give a warning about your connection not being private. Click on advanced and continue to localhost.
- Here you will set the username and password for Sunshine, set it to something simple and memorable. It will ask for it every time.
- The page will reload and then you will log into Sunshine. 
- Now its time to open Moonlight on your handheld. 
- First head to the *"Settings Menu"* and set them how you would like. Preferably start off with a low bitrate and your devices native resolution and framerate. 
- Lets move to the *"Connect Menu"*. Here you will first set your host device IP-address. 
- You will be able to find this by going to your network settings, properties and under *"IPv4 address"*.
- Now its time to pair. Head to the *"Pin"* section on your host PC. 
- Click *"Pair"* in the Moonlight port. This will now show a pin. Fill this pin into Sunshine. Also fill in the device name, this can be named after your device such a *"RG35XX"*. 
- After sending the signal on you host PC, you will receive a message *"Succesfully paired"* in the moonlight app on your handheld. 
- Head over to the *"Reload Apps"* function on your handheld. Click on it and you will see the currently configured apps from Sunshine. Every time you update the Apps in Sunshine, use this function.
- Head to the *"Play Menu"* and select the app you want to stream, Steam for example. 
- The Moonlight app will close on your handheld and it will start streaming. Wait 5 seconds for the controls.
- Have fun!

## Recommendations: ##
- Moonlight requires a very good internet connection to get a decent experience. There are many factors at play such a the detail of the game your running. Simpler 2d games are easier to stream and require less power to decode on your handheld. You will have to try and find a balance of bitrate and framerate for your setup. 
- Experiencing input and/or audio delay? Lower the bitrate, resolution, or framerate. Reconnecting may help random desyncing issues.
- Moonlight will maintain aspect ratio of your host PC monitor. You can get a better picture by manually changing the resolution to your devices native resolution, such as 640x480. There are ways to automate this process, such as  [ResolutionAutomation](https://github.com/Nonary/ResolutionAutomation). Use these programs on your own risk.
- Inputs may be reversed. Mouse mode does not work on Moonlight-Embedded. Both can be resolved by using SteamInput.
- Its recommended to check your connection before streaming, use the pair function for this. Does it say *"Already paired"*, then youre good to go. It may also say something like *"App already opened"*, you need to use *"Force Close"* under the troubleshooting options in Sunshine.
- Most important of all, dont expect an amazing experience going in. These handhelds are not ideal for Streaming, even though they may seem like it.

Eliminate all invaders using your egg bomb, but beware of hot areas as you will have difficulty moving through them.

games.title: Professor Layton Curious Village HD
games.desc: A remaster of the puzzle-adventure classic. Professor Layton and his apprentice Luke arrive in the village of St. Mystere to solve the mystery of the Golden Apple, and find a place where every resident answers a question with a riddle. Over 130 puzzles, hand-drawn art and fully animated cutscenes, rebuilt in HD.
games.instructionsRaw:
Purchase Layton: Curious Village in HD on Google Play and install it on an Android device. Install SAI: https://github.com/Aefyr/SAI/releases/tag/4.5 on that device. In SAI, open the Backup tab, find Layton: Curious Village in HD, and export it. The game is a split install, so this produces an APK file containing several APKs rather than a single one. Copy the APK to your computer, rename it to .zip and extract it. 

You only need two of the pieces:
  - "split_config.arm64_v8a.apk" — contains "lib/"
  - "split_InstallAssets.apk" — contains "assets/" (about 580 MB, the bulk of the game)

Extract the "lib" folder from "split_config.arm64_v8a.apk", and the "assets" folder from "split_InstallAssets.apk" (APKs are ordinary zip files, so any archiver opens them).

Copy both folders into "ports/layton1/" so they sit next to "laytonloader". Run Professor Layton and the Curious Village HD.

Check folder structure below if you are confused where to copy the files!
games.instructionsMd:
- Purchase Layton: Curious Village in HD on [Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.Level5.LT1REU) and install it on an Android device.
- Install [SAI (Split APKs Installer) 4.5](https://github.com/Aefyr/SAI/releases/tag/4.5) on that device.
- In SAI, open the **Backup** tab, find *Layton: Curious Village in HD*, and export it. The game is a split install, so this produces an `.apk` file containing several APKs rather than a single one.
- Copy the `.apk` to your computer, rename it to `.zip` and extract it. You only need two of the pieces:
  - **`split_config.arm64_v8a.apk`** — contains `lib/`
  - **`split_InstallAssets.apk`** — contains `assets/` (about 580 MB, the bulk of the game)
- Extract the `lib` folder from `split_config.arm64_v8a.apk`, and the `assets` folder from `split_InstallAssets.apk` (APKs are ordinary zip files, so any archiver opens them).
- Copy both folders into `ports/layton1/` so they sit next to `laytonloader`.
- Run Professor Layton and the Curious Village HD.

Check folder structure below if you are confused where to copy the files!
games.requiredDataHint: Поместите файлы игры в подпапку ports/layton1/assets/

To clear lines, you must connect the same color of sand from wall to wall across the screen, making it more challenging than traditional block-stacking games.
games.instructionsRaw:
Free Version (Itch.io):
- Download the game (Linux version) from https://mslivo.itch.io/sandtrix
- Place the tar.gz file in sandtrix/gamefiles/
- First startup can take a while, as files need to be extracted

Paid version / Demo Version (Steam):
- Purchase the game from https://store.steampowered.com/app/2546310/Sandtrix/ (Or get the demo)
- Download the game and locate the folder with the game files
- Look for the .jar file and place it in sandtrix/gamefiles

games.title: Wargus
games.desc: Wargus is a Warcraft 2 Mod that allows you to play Warcraft 2 with the Stratagus engine. The game looks and sounds almost exactly like Warcraft 2. The gameplay is very close to Warcraft 2’s gameplay, with slight enhancements towards Starcraft and other more modern RTS games.
games.instructionsRaw: Please read until the end to see which versions are not supported. For the GOG version (2019) copy the setup_warcraft_ii_*.exe and setup_warcraft_ii_*.bin file to /wargus/gamefiles/. For the Warcraft II Battle.net Edition CD (1999) - Copy all the files from the CD into /wargus/gamefiles/ (All files NOT just INSTALL.EXE/MPQ). Then just run the game. This will take longer on first startup to extract the assets (15min to 60min). For the DOS floppy disk version - Copy all the files from the DOS game's data directory into /wargus/gamefiles/ to get the music working download FluidR3_GM.sf2 from https://member.keymusician.com/Member/FluidR3_GM/ and place it in /wargus/data/. The DOS CD version doesn't seem to work fails with 'INVALID TITLE WITH QUOTES' it may expect the original CD to extract audio tracks - there are some similar issues in the wargus github. WarCraft II Remastered (2024) asset extraction is not supported you must have an older copy of the game. Don't mix sources - if you try with another source backup your saves in conf, delete the wargus directory because the data directory may be tainted and start again.
